packages.title: Establish the execution baseline and release scope
packages.progress: September 30 record: Execution baseline captured; original dirty work preserved. Named human owners and first-release cohort decisions remain unconfirmed. October 7 user scope recorded: Cameroon first, full phased implementation across sessions, pre-production/demo data. Existing work preserved; accountable external reviewers remain unassigned.
packages.nextAction: Confirm D01–D08 and assign accountable reviewers before any release decision.
packages.acceptance: Every in-scope capability has an owner, release boundary, acceptance scenario and evidence location; no critical finding is silently dropped.
packages.releaseGate: G0: scope, owners, baseline and decision register recorded.

packages.title: Restore a reproducible test, typecheck and policy-gate baseline
packages.progress: September 30 record: Repaired 18 stale assertions; full-scope typecheck passes. Report/payroll gate pair passes 351 tests, with final changed-clause follow-ups passing. Frozen app build passes compilation, lint/types, static generation and tracing but exits1 on Windows standalone symlink EPERM. Packaging recovery fails: one missing trace file and dependencies resolving outside its output. Relocated runtime was not run. Workspace-backed authenticated smoke renders four dashboards and shows one truthful module denial; reconciliation retains an unclassified visible alert and no workflow-success claim. October 7: regenerated stale local Prisma client; repaired two close-evidence literal-inference errors without changing query values. Final full no-emit typecheck exit 0; targeted lint exit 0; 59 focused tests passed. Integrated build/package and browser remain unqualified.
packages.nextAction: Run a fresh integrated build/package and controlled authenticated browser; retain the passing October 7 compiler receipt separately from historical build evidence.
packages.acceptance: Every historical failure is reproduced, fixed or superseded with evidence; normal commands complete; unresolved domain gates remain visible and blocking for their scope.
packages.releaseGate: G0 verification gate: reproducible normal runner and completed typecheck/build; all remaining blockers assigned to their actual domain package.

packages.title: Correct currency authority, FX conversion and locked settings
packages.progress: Manual FX creation/posting validates explicit rates and stored base amounts; functional-currency reporting rejects missing evidence; unsupported base-currency transitions are rejected.
packages.nextAction: Review historical missing amounts and rate provenance policy; do not release affected reports before R09 disposition.
packages.acceptance: Posting, reversal and reporting agree with independent expected base amounts; historical currency cannot be silently relabeled.
packages.releaseGate: G1 finance: no mixed-currency professional statement until fixture and current-data impact review pass.

packages.title: Enforce source-owned corrections and compensating effects
packages.progress: Generic posting/reversal admits MANUAL sources only; all source-owned enum cases are covered by denial tests.
packages.nextAction: Prove each supported source-owned compensating workflow and PostgreSQL duplicate/failure races.
packages.acceptance: Every journal source has an explicit tested correction policy; no supported correction strands inventory, cash or subledger balances.
packages.releaseGate: G1 corrections: source-owned reversal bypass denied and approved compensation lifecycle proved.
packages.reviewerRole: POS, inventory, AP and payroll owners

packages.title: Make the offline queue durable and migrate existing records safely
packages.progress: Transactional IndexedDB queue, atomic sequence allocation, corruption quarantine and conservative legacy migration implemented; real-browser tests pass.
packages.nextAction: Qualify supported devices, eviction policy, older-client shutdown and operator recovery/export before pilot.
packages.acceptance: Concurrent capture, corrupt storage and interrupted migration cannot silently lose acknowledged events; recovery limitations are visible to operators.
packages.releaseGate: G1 offline durability; production replay stays disabled pending R32.

packages.title: Recover interrupted sync and reconcile uncertain outcomes
packages.progress: Persisted leases, original-identity retries, uncertain outcome recovery, cross-tab exclusion and complete acknowledgement checks implemented.
packages.nextAction: Prove one sale/stock/journal effect jointly in a browser and disposable PostgreSQL after lost response; implement governed recovery UI.
packages.acceptance: No event remains permanently stranded solely because it was SYNCING at restart; duplicate/uncertain responses cannot multiply effects.
packages.releaseGate: G1 replay recovery and later G4 offline pilot.

packages.title: Correct fiscal boundaries and general-ledger balances
packages.progress: First fiscal period clips to actual year start. General ledger uses opening balances and a repeatable-read snapshot; exports add a hashed summary including empty ranges and apply the selected period to actual query bounds.
packages.nextAction: Complete independent accountant/browser acceptance and disposition the 22 historical entry/period date candidates.
packages.acceptance: Period bounds are valid and opening/movement/closing tie to independently selected journal populations.
packages.releaseGate: G1 accounting reports and calendar invariants.

packages.title: Unify period close, assurance, invalidation and certified exports
packages.progress: Period close requires a completed current non-blocked assessment, checks live blocking findings, records its run ID, and rejects incomplete/unbalanced functional amounts. Assessment invalidation and finalization fixes are separately verified.
packages.nextAction: Complete a shared writer/close locking contract and late-evidence policy, then prove all PostgreSQL interleavings and fresh source coverage.
packages.acceptance: Close, reopen, correction and export share documented semantics and pass concurrent/failure-path tests.
packages.releaseGate: G1 close truth; G2 requires all in-scope source lifecycles.

packages.title: Strengthen database integrity and records retention
packages.progress: September 30 record: Added database guards for posted-line mutations, tenant consistency and posted status regression. Three original invalid-write probes now reject on the restored copy; eight compatibility checks and seventeen supplemental checks pass. Clean 89-migration replay and repeat deployment pass; populated-copy deploy/status also pass. Payroll SQL approval/duplicate/failure checks pass. October 7: HR time-request terminal decision is conditionally claimed before transactional effects. Four isolated PostgreSQL stale-read/rollback tests pass; broader database boundaries and shared leave-balance concurrency remain open.
packages.nextAction: Complete posted-header/late-insert/parent-retention boundaries, reciprocal tenant guards, draft-post races and deployed least-privilege verification.
packages.acceptance: Illegal writes are rejected, legitimate workflows pass, tenancy and retention rules are documented and migration behavior is demonstrated.
packages.releaseGate: G2 database integrity; schema rollout only after upgrade and recovery evidence.

packages.title: Assess and correct historical data without rewriting evidence
packages.progress: Read-only scan found 120 missing-base lines across 24 journals and 22 out-of-period journals. All candidates carry four synthetic-seed markers; a capture-only reproduction matches the exact counts. The future seed producer now writes base amounts and chooses periods from actual dates. Existing records remain unchanged.
packages.nextAction: Review fixture regeneration on a separate disposable database; preserve original evidence. For any business/mixed-provenance population, prepare source-owned corrections with independently reviewed historical evidence.
packages.acceptance: Each suspected anomaly has an evidence-backed disposition; any approved correction is traceable and all affected reports are rebuilt with versions.
packages.releaseGate: G3 data-impact disposition: verified no impact, approved restriction, or completed reconciled repair for each release cohort.

packages.title: Prove access, tenant isolation and privacy across entry points
packages.progress: September 30 record: No completion claim in this execution batch; prior implementation and planning evidence still require current package-specific acceptance. October 7: HR approval UI truthfully handles denied/stale-auth action results; existing action/service guard regressions pass. This is not a complete role/tenant/surface matrix.
packages.nextAction: Build a role/tenant/module/action matrix for browser routes, actions, APIs, exports, uploads, workers and delegated accountant access.
packages.acceptance: Every public or delegated entry point has positive and negative authorization evidence and no unresolved critical tenant/privacy bypass.
packages.releaseGate: G2 access/privacy matrix complete for release scope; critical bypasses block all affected cohorts.
